# Ticket-runner publication boundary

The approved ticket runner may publish only its owned ticket branches and reviewed PRs to `mimir-studio` (or explicitly identified smoke branches) in `wasimysaid/unsloth` and private `wasimysaid/mimir`. Neither main branch nor `unslothai/unsloth` is a target.

Private Mimir source, raw provider errors, prompts, traces, and unsanitized test logs must not be copied into public PR/issue bodies or evidence documents. A public runtime lock may identify a private source revision without containing that source.

The operator's final implemented-UI review and GPU capacity coordination cannot be substituted by agent self-approval. See `docs/agents/mimir-ticket-runner.md`.
